answer: To join, an agent reserves one orchard gate for ten days and prepays a 75-unit bond. While the gate is held, it publishes six staggered work packets; each commits to a 25-minute zephyr-corridor VDF whose input is the gate id plus the previous packet hash, so aliases cannot farm packets in parallel. Clerks countersign only after seeing a packet on two independent river-bank relays that do not share operators. A reused gate key, identical VDF transcript, or matching device fingerprint burns the bond and bars that fingerprint for 28 days. No sponsor may reserve more than two gates per fortnight.
